create_logger_instance: create a Logger instance that initializes loguru with a custom format and stdout handler
setup_logger_stdout: setup the logger to output formatted log messages to stdout with level, time, and location info
get_logger_instance: get the configured loguru logger instance from a Logger object for use in your code
filter_logs_main_process: filter log records so only the main process logs when accelerate is available
review_logger_class: review the Logger class and its methods for custom loguru logging configuration
